text: Artificial intelligence is changing how we work. Many companies now use automation to handle boring, repeated tasks. This saves time and reduces mistakes. AI productivity tools, such as smart calendars and writing assistants, help employees finish their work faster. Instead of replacing people completely, AI often works together with humans. For example, doctors use AI to check X-rays, but they still make the final decision. However, some jobs are disappearing while new ones are appearing. Workers need to learn new skills to stay competitive. Overall, AI can make our work easier, but we must adapt to these changes.
